# Introduction
Taken captive you a thrown into the Pit for the amusement of the Boss and the Mob baying for blood.</br>
The Boss offers you one chance at freedom. Fight you way through his thugs, beasts and monstrous menagerie and claim the title, Champion of the Pit.</br>
Win and earn your freedom,</br>
Lose and join the countless others beneath the dirt of... </br>
**THE PIT!**

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"theme": "redux-color", "themeVariables":{primaryTextColor": #151010}}}%%
flowchart TD
    classDef action fill: #ff000066, color: #000000
    classDef startend fill: #3fcf3f, color: #000000
    classDef comment fill: #ffff99, stroke-dasharray:5 5, color: #000000
    classDef condition fill: #cb4bcb88, color: #000000
    classDef data fill: #33ff00aa, color: #000000
    A(Start)--->B
    B[/Display introduction/]--->C[/Player selects starting class/]
    B1(Determines starting stats and ability) -.- C
    C--->D[/Players selects starting Weapon/]
    D--->E[/Player selects starting Armour/]
    E--->F['difficulty=0']
    F--->G[Select Foe from list.difficulty]
    G--->H[/player fights Foe/]
    H--->J{Did player defeat Foe}
    J-- No -->K(Game Over)
    J-- Yes -->L[/Player levels up, select 1 attribute to increase/]
    L--->M{Has player atribute increased to level that will unlock new ability}
    M--yes-->N[/reward player new ability, tell them, and describe it/]
    N--->P[/player recieves loot/]
    M--No-->P
    P--->Q[difficulty +=1]
    Q--->U{is difficulty>5}
    U--No-->G
    U--Yes-->u{is difficulty >6}
    u--No-->R[/player fights champion/]
    R--->S{Did player defeat champion}
    S--No-->K
    S--Yes-->T[/player fights Pit Boss/]
    T--->V{Did player defeat Pit Boss?}
    V--no-->K
    V--yes-->W[/Congratulations, you have escaped the pit!/]
    

    class V,u,M,J,U,S condition
    class B1 comment
    class K,A startend
    class T,W,R,N,P,H,B,C,D,E,L action
    class F,G data
    
```
